510631.name: Toxic Bullet
510631.description:
Fires a toxic bullet from its back, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
Deals additional damage if the attack hits.

510632.name: Contaminated Projectile
510632.description:
Launches a barrage of projectiles, dealing damage to multiple Nikkes.
Deals significant sustained damage if the attack hits more than once.
Can be interrupted by destroying the Poison Chamber.

510634.name: Shock Wave
510634.description: Ultra smashes the ground, dealing massive damage to all Nikkes.

510635.name: Toxic Shells
510635.description:
Spews toxic shells from its mouth, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Deals significant sustained damage if the attack hits.

510636.name: Toxic Dust
510636.description:
Collects and shoots toxic dust, dealing massive damage to a single Nikke.
Ultra generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while collecting toxic dust. While the barrier is up, only Iron Code Nikkes can deal damage.

510638.name: Toxic Substance Spray
510638.description: Ejects a powerful toxic substance from its entire body. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals massive damage to all Nikkes.
